questions.question: What does a materialized view store?
options: Precomputed results of a supported query
Only SQL text with no data

questions.question: What is BigQuery smart tuning?
options: Optimizer rewriting of compatible base-table queries to use a materialized view

questions.question: Why align a materialized view partition with its base table?
options: It forces every partition to scan
Affected partitions can be maintained independently where supported
It makes the view logical only

questions.question: What does BI Engine primarily provide?
options: In-memory caching and vectorized acceleration for supported query stages

questions.question: How should an engineer verify that smart tuning used a materialized view?
options: Inspect query plan and materialized-view statistics
Assume any matching column name proves it

questions.question: Why can a query remain slow even with BI Engine enabled?
options: Only supported subqueries are accelerated and reservation pressure can remain

questions.question: What should query troubleshooting examine first?
Does LIMIT alone guarantee fewer bytes scanned?
options: No, the engine may still scan the required input

questions.question: Which change most directly reduces scan bytes?
options: Select needed columns and use pruneable partition filters

questions.question: What does a hot join key usually cause?
A query spends most wall time waiting before execution while slots are saturated. What is the likely issue?
Why can breaking one huge SQL statement into staged results help?
options: It can reduce plan complexity, improve reuse, and localize diagnosis

questions.question: What is BigQuery ML's main value?
options: Create, evaluate, and use supported models with SQL near warehouse data

questions.question: Which task still requires careful design with BigQuery ML?
When is BigQuery ML a strong baseline choice?
options: When models require custom hardware kernels only
When SQL-accessible data and supported models fit the problem

questions.question: What should a reproducible BigQuery ML run record?
options: Dataset snapshot, training query, options, preprocessing, and evaluation split

questions.question: Why can random row splits produce misleading evaluation?
options: Related entities or future examples can cross train and test
Random splits always have no labels

questions.question: What is the best response to one strong aggregate evaluation metric?
options: Inspect relevant slices, leakage risks, and deployment compatibility

questions.question: What does ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING return for compatible input?
options: An embedding vector plus associated result or status fields

questions.question: What does VECTOR_SEARCH do?
options: Finds nearest base-table embeddings to query vectors

questions.question: Why must row-level remote inference status be checked?
options: A query job can complete while some rows have endpoint or input errors

questions.question: What changes when VECTOR_SEARCH uses a vector index?
options: Search can use ANN, trading some recall for performance

questions.question: How should approximate vector-index quality be measured?
options: Compare ANN top-k with brute-force exact search across representative queries

questions.question: Why must model revision and output dimensionality be part of embedding lineage?
options: Changed models or dimensions produce incompatible vector spaces

questions.question: What does a BigQuery object table primarily represent?
options: Read-only metadata over objects in Cloud Storage

questions.topic: Preparing Unstructured Data for Embeddings and RAG
questions.question: What must parsing preserve for grounded citations?
options: Source version plus page, block, or span mapping

questions.topic: Preparing Unstructured Data for Embeddings and RAG
questions.question: Which identity should an embedding row carry?
options: Stable chunk and source-version IDs plus model version

questions.topic: Preparing Unstructured Data for Embeddings and RAG
questions.question: Why deduplicate overlapping retrieved chunks before prompt construction?
options: To avoid wasting token budget and overweighting repeated evidence

questions.topic: Preparing Unstructured Data for Embeddings and RAG
questions.question: Which layered evaluation best diagnoses a weak RAG answer?
options: Check parsing, chunking, embedding success, retrieval, citations, and grounded generation separately

questions.topic: Preparing Unstructured Data for Embeddings and RAG
questions.question: When might external processing remain appropriate despite warehouse-native features?
options: When complex parsing, low-latency serving, or specialized ANN behavior requires it
